title: Daalat gidaaritteh addat qeltut tan imaan
intro: celsis kee kaxxiinak kibbimte qanxaffele cokmih buxah gudet, dubuk yan rooci qawwalayla le sirri yabbixe. Cayla kee rabi bohoyut marrooweh yan ta Yallih taama abeynit farmoyti inki Imperiyaal dubuk soolam wagta. tibba centibbaaru takke wak, cankâ qawwalaylah addat nummat yaaboonuh libdole margaqa beyaanam faxxinta.
clues: Anu elle waartem caylaleeh, Yallih astooti dirableeh, kaxxina le ummattah fanat suge.
Anu inni imaan udduruh qelliseh suge too yi dariifal yan mari farmoytal qagitak massoysak suge wak.
Anu qaduuk yaabeh, axcem: atu numtin amoh qiddam, oson yi Rabbi Yalla iyyeenih, qado sumaqta temeete wak?
Anu inni ummatta dumaahi agattiinah sarrimaane kee ittak ittah seecoh ayro wagittaamal takkaawiseh.
Anu keenih warseh too anu ayfaf ece mirac dubuk ceenale mabla yaybulle, uxih akheera numma buxa.
exceh: yi-ummattaw yoo kataytaay cakki gital sin miraaciseyyo, kaadu Yalli yoo cateh ken umaanek.

trial.label: Anu maca abeeh?
options: kobxisen gadditte miyyin maftacitte quuki maqar le mara
Muusa rabbi tabluh fayya le kalqata xisen.
Uqrat tan imaan sarra qaduk kalalteh muusa kee yi ummatta takkaawisa
addah tan xongolo bicissa dahabak tan ruga bicsen
Gita alfeeh farmoyti gaddaliinol wayyu tusuuleh.
trial.answer: Uqrat tan imaan sarra qaduk kalalteh muusa kee yi ummatta takkaawisa

outcome.label: Yi Xali Maca Sugteeh?
options: Anu kurruume badih addat qande lih cule.
Anu sabti ayro yiggileh sugeemih taagah damaaqe fan koreh suge
Yalli yoo dacrise ken cogdah umaanek .
outcome.answer: Yalli yoo dacrise ken cogdah umaanek .

arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُوا۟ ۖ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ
verse: So Allāh protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment - (40:45)
